moments.action: High wide of the trackside path at golden hour, figures tiny in the distance; the camera drops to ground level and M walks the alley behind Amah, reaching up to pull at an overhanging branch as other locals pass.
A long held take on a shaded lane: M walks alone into frame carrying a bag, then stops; by the end of the take Amah in her sun hat has caught up and the two stand together facing down the empty road.

A hazy Bangkok skyline over rooftops marks the time jump, then a busy hospital lobby where Amah waits in wheelchair 24 in her knit cap; the last shot holds on a closed consulting-room door that opens onto a doctor at his desk with a patient.
